title: FAQ: Light Blue Account
summary: This FAQ for the Light Blue Account states that monthly maintenance fee is $0.00, overdraft fee is $0.00, paper statement fee is $0.00/month, returned deposit fee is $0.00, and domestic incoming wire fee is $0.00. It also sets an EveryonePay daily sending limit of $1,500.
